features.title: Touched by divinity
features.text: Exemplars carry a divine spark in three ikons, special weapons, worn items or parts of their body. One ikon holds the spark at a time.

features.title: Spark transcendence
features.text: The active ikon grants an ongoing benefit. Release its special power to move the spark to another ikon and gain that ikon's benefit.

review.notes: Editorial assessment of the class framework and ordinary builds. Rules references support mechanics; scores remain judgments.

ratings.offense: 4–5 → 4–5. Weapon ikons and transcendence choices support strong martial damage.
ratings.defense: 3–4 → 3–4.5. Body and worn ikon choices can favor protection instead of offense.
ratings.support: 2–4 → 2–4. Some ikons offer healing or team benefits; weapon-heavy choices do less for allies.
ratings.utility: 2–3 → 2–3. Ikons and epithets add selected tricks rather than a broad spell repertoire.
ratings.difficulty: 3.5 → 3.5. Moving the divine spark and timing transcendence create a repeating but choice-rich loop.
